description: Computerized Iowa Gambling Task (cIGT) using an externally supplied, trial-by-trial ABCD gain/loss schedule instead of the fixed 40-card Bechara deck.

parameters.name: gainfile
parameters.description: Tab-separated file giving each deck's own gain schedule. One row per card in that deck's sequence (e.g., 60 rows = 60 cards per deck), 4 columns (A,B,C,D).

parameters.name: lossfile
parameters.description: Tab-separated file giving each deck's own loss schedule (0 or negative), aligned row-for-row with gainfile.

parameters.name: numtrials
parameters.description: Total number of card selections (trials) the participant makes across the whole task. This is independent of how many cards/rows are defined for each individual deck (see gainfile/lossfile) -- e.g., 100 total trials drawn from 4 decks that each have a 60-row schedule.

parameters.name: UseMouse
parameters.description: Should we use the mouse (use=1; don't use=0 for the keyboard)

parameters.name: shuffledecks
parameters.description: Whether each deck's own gain/loss sequence should be shuffled in epochs of 10 before the task starts. Default is off (sequence is presented in the order given in the data files).

parameters.name: rewarddelay
parameters.description: How long (ms) the reward feedback is shown before any penalty feedback is shown

parameters.name: penaltydelay
parameters.description: How long (ms) the penalty feedback is shown

parameters.name: DelayBetweenTrials
parameters.description: How long (ms) to pause between trials

parameters.name: displaycounter
parameters.description: If 1, show the running numeric total next to 'Winnings:'. If 0, only the bar graph is shown.
